items.quote: Several respondents noted that Joko participated in teamwork across departments on the annual review as a team member.
Peers observed that Joko participated in drafting legislative amendments for the new act as a team member.
Joko managed public communications on the new scheme for his unit.
Peers observed that Joko delivered his share of the innovation lab's experiments on service design reliably.
Direct reports said that Joko assisted with the organisational restructuring of the department.
Direct reports said that Joko contributed effectively to analytics to guide resource allocation.
